profiles.name: Mohamad Hasan
profiles.position: Minister of Foreign Affairs; Deputy President of UMNO
profiles.description: Mohamad Hasan, also known as Tok Mat, is Minister of Foreign Affairs and represents Rembau in Negeri Sembilan. He is Deputy President of UMNO, a component of Barisan Nasional.

profiles.name: Alexander Nanta Linggi
profiles.description: Alexander Nanta Linggi is Minister of Works and Member of Parliament for Kapit in Sarawak. He is a member of PBB, a component of Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS).

milestones.title: Launch ASEAN Community Vision 2045 at the May 2025 summit
milestones.description: Mohamad Hasan announced that ASEAN Community Vision 2045 and its strategic plans would be launched at the 46th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur in May 2025.
milestones.progress_note: ASEAN’s official Kuala Lumpur Declaration dated 26 May 2025 establishes adoption of the vision and accompanying plans. Achieved is limited to this shared ASEAN launch/adoption milestone, not delivery of the vision’s long-term goals or sole personal credit. No numerical completion score is assigned.

milestones.title: Complete the Kota Bharu–Kuala Krai highway by 2027
milestones.description: Nanta reported a 2027 completion forecast for the remaining packages of the 70.4-kilometre Kota Bharu–Kuala Krai highway.
milestones.progress_note: Reported overall physical progress was 78.80% on 27 October 2026; the bar rounds this to 79%. Pasir Hor–Kadok was complete while five packages remained under construction. This is reported construction progress, not an independent audit or a percentage of time or cost saved. The date shown is the current delivery forecast, not an assessment of earlier schedules.

milestones.title: Complete the remaining Pan Borneo Sabah Phase 1 packages by 2030
milestones.description: Nanta stated that the remaining 31 of 35 Pan Borneo Sabah Phase 1 work packages would be completed progressively by 2030.
milestones.progress_note: The October 2026 statement reports four completed packages, Phase 1A physical progress of 89.54% and Phase 1B progress of 25.53%. These phase-specific percentages are not combined or presented as overall completion because the required weighting was not supplied. Overall completion therefore remains blank.

methodology: Editorial records of attributed commitments, not endorsements or independently audited political-performance scores. Outcome dates and review dates are distinct. Published sector metrics are not converted into completion scores. Year-only deadlines use year-end date markers.
